sources.quote: All values were previously reported in denominations of thousands and have been updated in this amendment to reflect exact dollar values in accordance with Form 13F requirements.
Legacy systems that still round to thousands are producing non-compliant filings.
sources.page_context: 5148 in June 2022. The amended form became required starting January 3, 2023. If your systems or templates predate that change, you may still be filing incorrectly. The five key changes: Rounding to the nearest dollar. Dollar values must now be rounded to the nearest dollar, not the nearest $1,000. Legacy systems that still round to thousands are producing non-compliant filings. CRD and SEC file numbers required. Managers must now report their Central Registration Depository (CRD) number and SEC file number, if any. FIGI as a supplemental identifier.
